rootCause.effect: Rendered cluster motion can temporarily violate rigid common-radius and projected-clearance invariants even though settled static fixtures pass.

transformation.pushWrapperPurpose: Execute the already-locked transformation after the newly introduced PR workflow proved ineligible to run from the pull-request event.
requiredChanges: Resolve one shared runtime cluster radius from actual compositor bounds and projection facts.
Apply one uniform scale factor to all four law members only when radius expansion alone cannot satisfy the bounded viewport and Compass-clearance envelope.
Preserve the 1.40 minimum common radius, four-member XY plane, -PI/2 phase, 90-degree spacing, and 0.30-radian tilt bound.
Remove secondary per-node XYZ interpolation for active law clusters because quaternion interpolation already owns smooth rigid motion.
Suppress per-law floating translation while a law cluster is active.
Consume the declared 8-pixel clearance margin in compositor projection checks.
Publish runtime radius, uniform scale, resolution attempts, and pass state in the crystals receipt and root dataset.

executionTrigger.triggerCommitPurpose: Activate the self-removing push wrapper without changing product scope.
